GT_CAPABILITIES.title: AI search & visibility
GT_CAPABILITIES.desc: Help the business get discovered as search changes. Optimize content and digital presence for traditional search as well as AI-powered discovery, answer engines and emerging search experiences.

GT_CAPABILITIES.title: SEO
GT_CAPABILITIES.desc: Build sustainable organic visibility around the topics, products and services that matter to the business. Combine technical SEO, content strategy, on-page optimization and authority building to attract relevant search demand.

GT_CAPABILITIES.title: Content & demand generation
GT_CAPABILITIES.desc: Create content and campaigns that attract the right audience, build consideration and generate qualified demand. Develop thought leadership, lead-generation assets and campaigns around real customer needs and buying journeys.

GT_CAPABILITIES.title: Performance marketing
GT_CAPABILITIES.desc: Reach high-intent audiences through paid search, social and other digital channels. Build campaigns around clear objectives, continuously optimize performance and focus investment on qualified traffic and conversions.

GT_CAPABILITIES.title: Conversion & journey optimization
GT_CAPABILITIES.desc: Turn more of the right traffic into meaningful action. Identify friction across landing pages, forms, journeys and digital experiences, then test and improve what influences conversion.

GT_CAPABILITIES.title: Marketing analytics & automation
GT_CAPABILITIES.desc: Connect marketing data, automation and measurement to improve decision-making, personalize engagement and make marketing operations more efficient.
